title: Casimir
dek: A questioning adventurer whose procedural reasoning and loyalty to Alioth expose the difference between understanding an institution and giving it first claim.
sources: Deep character dossier · supplied 14 October 2026; quest evidence takes precedence
Selected primary scenes and established public histories; anchors below
body:
Casimir approaches uncertainty by looking for the structure of a problem: what must be agreed to, what can be asked and what an answer will actually establish. His close relationship with Alioth makes those questions personal rather than merely abstract.

September 2024 · questions before commitment

Before the Rahu trial he bows to Ephraith and asks permission to question her. She welcomes the inquiry. He asks whether she intends to join Cala and Nuru against Death; the exchange shows respect for authority without treating its premises as beyond question.

His questioning is an observed choice. The answers remain their speakers’ positions, rather than the Codex’s own verdict on cosmology or the legitimacy of every Rahu practice.

Alioth and the institutional verdict

The trial ends with Casimir holding Alioth tightly, visibly emotional. Ephraith says they have chosen each other over the Rahu and have failed. Alioth argues that their loyalty is strength; Casimir accepts living with the consequences.

The institution’s refusal is real. It does not make the relationship a failure, nor does Alioth’s disagreement overturn the trial result. Their choice reveals a priority that differs from the commitment the Rahu demand.

Questions within constraints

The existing account of Olokun’s oath preserves Casimir exploring yes-or-no questions, truth magic and the information conveyed by refusal. He looks for ways others might understand without requiring Olokun to speak a forbidden answer.

This is a recognizable method, not proof that every loophole honors an oath’s purpose. The limits of a spell and the limits of another person’s consent are separate. Neither Casimir’s intelligence nor his affection gives him an unlimited right to extract knowledge.

Care after the fighting

After the violence at a concert billed as a benefit for Eovar, Alioth moves among the company offering healing. Casimir checks whether she is all right. His attention then turns to the aftermath: he offers to help clear the venue and arrange another concert, while insisting that Carmen should be paid double.

The offer broadens the picture of his loyalty beyond private affection or clever questions. He recognizes practical work and another companion’s contribution. It remains an offer; the checked exchange does not establish a completed cleanup, second concert or payment.

Getting people under cover

During the later September passage, Casimir ushers the company into a tower and brings Binulette inside with him. He warns Alioth away from the doorway, closes it and looks for a way to bar it. The company works together to block the entrance.

As the need for silence continues, he proposes written notes and asks how their movements might be concealed. Alioth offers to scatter the traces in the dirt. They adapt together to an immediate threat; the record does not make the tower permanently secure or identify the entire realm through their theories.

The open history

His earlier life, complete later career and consequences of these decisions remain only partly reconstructed. Casimir and Alioth’s shared history retains both voices; his independent entry does not merge them into one person or assign him Alioth’s beliefs.

  1. 2024-09-03 · quest

    Accepting an institutional refusal

    Casimir accepts the consequences after Ephraith says he and Alioth chose each other and failed the trial.

    Known at this stage
    The institution has judged the choice by its own requirements.
    Consequence
    His loyalty and the failed initiation coexist in the record.
    Still unresolved
    Alioth’s disagreement does not reverse the institutional outcome.

  2. 2024-09-15 · quest

    Offering work after a ruined concert

    Casimir checks on Alioth, offers help clearing the venue and argues for better payment for Carmen.

    Known at this stage
    The fighting has left a venue that cannot simply resume its purpose.
    Consequence
    His care reaches toward rebuilding and recognition of another companion’s work.
    Still unresolved
    The offer is not a completed cleanup or paid contract.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4

  3. 2024-09-25 · quest

    Shelter and a quieter plan

    Casimir brings companions under cover and proposes notes and concealment while the company needs silence.

    Known at this stage
    The doorway remains threatened and the safety of onward travel is uncertain.
    Consequence
    Procedural thought becomes immediate protection and cooperation.
    Still unresolved
    The scene does not establish permanent safety or complete geography.
